rationale: One blocking finding: updateCli in cli-updater.ts now spans ~69 lines against the documented under-50-line standard, introduced by this change. Edge-case and acceptance candidates were checked against source (7 dismissed as unreachable, graceful-degrade, or deliberate per plan AR-2/spec); no defers, standards fully adjudicated.

business_review.item: Locate first codemie via existing getCommandPath('codemie'), callers untouched
business_review.notes: lookupCommandPath wraps getCommandPath with a 5s guard; processes.ts untouched

business_review.item: Read active version without spawning (POSIX realpath + owning package.json; Windows shim + package)
business_review.notes: No codemie spawn. POSIX walk-up reaches package root (bin/ has no package.json); odd layouts degrade to unknown, i.e. today's text

business_review.item: Helper returns active path/version/prefix, never throws, prefix via getCodemieNpmPrefix
business_review.notes: findActiveCli returns found/unknown union inside try/catch

business_review.item: Compare with compareVersions; active >= installed keeps current success text
Stale: yellow warning with path, versions, fix (a) uninstall or (b) PATH order, new terminal
business_review.notes: Spec offers (a) or (b); (b) always present. Legacy prefix swaps (a) for installer/doctor per plan AR-2

business_review.item: Not determinable: today's text unchanged, reason logged via logger.debug
business_review.notes: unknown() logs debug; cli-updater wraps in try/catch

business_review.item: Silent mode: same check, one debug line on mismatch, no output
Exit code stays 0; self-update.ts and process.exit(0) unchanged
Non-goals respected (no auto-fix, getCommandPath unchanged, failure path unchanged)
business_review.notes: Diff limited to npm-prefix.ts helpers, active-cli.ts, success branch

business_review.item: AC1: stale older active prints warning with path, versions, fix steps, no takes-effect line
business_review.notes: PATH-order fix always present; uninstall fix omitted only for legacy prefix by design (AR-2)

business_review.item: AC2: active >= installed leaves output as today
AC3: undeterminable active install leaves output as today with debug reason
AC4: silent auto-update prints nothing new, mismatch at debug only
AC5: check never spawns codemie, never triggers update, never throws
AC6: works with POSIX which and Windows where.exe, spaces, extensionless shim
AC7: exit code 0 for every successful-update outcome
AC8: COMMANDS.md no longer claims unconditional takes effect on next command

standards_review.notes: git log diff_base..HEAD is empty: HEAD equals diff_base and the change is uncommitted, so there are no commit subjects to check.
Naming, .js extensions, return types, JSDoc, no console.log conform. Unmet: updateCli in cli-updater.ts is ~68 lines, code-quality.md requires functions under 50.

findings.title: updateCli exceeds the 50-line function limit
findings.problem: code-quality.md requires functions under 50 lines and one responsibility. updateCli now spans about 69 lines (284-352), up from about 46 before this change, combining install, failure reporting, active-CLI verification and silent/interactive output.
findings.impact: Documented code-quality standard is broken by lines this change added; the guide lists oversized functions as a Don't.
findings.recommendation: Extract the post-install block (verify active CLI, then silent logging or interactive success output with the stale warning) into a helper such as reportUpdateResult(latestVersion, silent) so updateCli drops back under 50 lines.
